title: Intrinsic Information-Theoretic Analysis of ReLU Nets
abstract: arXiv:2610.36864v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mutual information (MI) is fundamental to representation-learning analysis in deep networks, but in high dimensions MI estimators depend on hyperparameters whose bias often dominates the signal. We show that continuous piecewise-linear (CPWL) networks, including ReLU networks, admit an intrinsic information-theoretic analysis that avoids this pitfall: their inherent partition of the input space into convex linear regions assigns to every input a discrete region label $\Pi$ alongside the continuous representation $T$ and label $Y$. We introduce a decomposition of the mutual information $I(Y;T)$ into interpretable geometric terms. We show that the dominant term, the *routing information* $I(Y; \Pi)$, admits an estimable plug-in estimator, that in the well-sampled regime, approximates a population lower bound on the joint information $I(Y; \Pi, T)$. translated_title: ReLU网络的内在信息论分析
translated_abstract: 互信息（MI）是深度网络表示学习分析的基础，但在高维空间中，互信息估计器依赖于超参数，其偏差往往会盖过信号本身。我们证明，连续分段线性（CPWL）网络（包括ReLU网络）可以进行一种内在的信息论分析，从而避免这一缺陷：这类网络会将输入空间内在地划分为凸线性区域，从而为每个输入分配一个离散的区域标签 $\Pi$，与连续表示 $T$ 和标签 $Y$ 并存。我们引入了一种将互信息 $I(Y;T)$ 分解为可解释几何项的方法。我们证明了其中的主导项——*路由信息* $I(Y; \Pi)$——存在一个可估计的插件（plug-in）估计器，在充分采样的情况下，该估计器近似于联合信息 $I(Y; \Pi, T)$ 的总体下界。当划分达到饱和时，函数等价的商运算会将实现……（相同函数）的区域折叠合并（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文利用ReLU网络将输入空间固有划分为凸线性区域这一特性，把互信息分解为可解释的几何项，并提出无需超参数、可估计的“路由信息”插件估计器，从而实现对深度网络的内在信息论分析。
en_tdlr: This paper exploits the intrinsic partition of ReLU networks' input space into convex linear regions to decompose mutual information into interpretable geometric terms, introducing a hyperparameter-free, estimable plug-in estimator for "routing information" that enables an intrinsic information-theoretic analysis of deep networks.
